headline: Names a post office in Tomahawk, Wisconsin after Einar "Sarge" H. Ingman, Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 311 West Wisconsin Avenue in Tomahawk, Wisconsin. The building will be officially called the "Einar 'Sarge' H. Ingman, Jr. Post Office Building." It is a naming measure and does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
